author: Arnav
problem: needed maps each grocery item (a singular noun that takes 's' in the plural) to how many to buy. Return one shopping-list line per item, in the dict's order, written as in English, like '3 eggs' or '1 lemon'.
bug_description: Adds the 's' only when count > 1, so a count of 0 gets the singular ('0 onion').

comments.accurate: One line per item: the count, then the item name in singular or plural to match
comments.wrong_behavior: One line per item, adding an 's' to the name when more than one is needed
comments.wrong_location: Plural choice verified; check the count and item name are written in the right order
